title: Narak Putra (Hellboy)

desc: A group of friends facing mid-life crises decide to remake a favorite youth film, but enter a jungle and encounter surprising challenges that reshape their lives.

desc: A battle across galaxies unfolds as superheroes unite to stop a mad Titan from erasing half of all life, testing alliances, courage, and sacrifice on an epic scale.
